I am an Associate Professor in the Department of Physics at IIT Tirupati, where I have been a faculty member since November 2018. My work connects theoretical atomic physics, experimental plasma diagnostics, and applied low-temperature plasma research.

I received my Ph.D. in Physics from IIT Roorkee in 2012. Before joining IIT Tirupati, I held postdoctoral positions at Université de Montréal, Canada, and the Weizmann Institute of Science, Israel, and served as an Assistant Professor at VNIT Nagpur.
